text: In March 2026 Eni announced a reorganisation of Plenitude's shareholding after which Eni expects to hold close to 65% of Plenitude and share control with Ares, an existing shareholder.

source.name: Eni S.p.A.: Eni deconsolidates Plenitude through a shareholding reorganization and a new governance structure
source.quote: Following the capital increase, Eni anticipates holding an equity stake of close to 65%, and expects to continue exercising direction and coordination rights over Plenitude

additionalSources.name: Il Sole 24 ORE (Celestina Dominelli, English edition): Eni deconsolidates Plenitude: start of 1.5 billion capital increase. Joint control with Ares
additionalSources.quote: Once the new injection of resources has been made, Eni will hold a stake of close to 65% of the share capital
